name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: If at least one of Slate goes with Muffin, Espresso goes with Greta, or Ristretto goes with Ivory, then Amber goes with Brioche.
Americano goes with exactly two of Ben, Danish, and Amber.
Either Latte goes with Amber or Rose goes with Brioche.
If Americano goes with Ben, then Ristretto goes with Muffin.
Between Espresso and Latte, one goes with Amber and the other with Slate.
Brioche does not go with Ivory if and only if both Slate does not go with Cara and Latte goes with Ava.
Ben goes with none of Latte, Rose, or Slate.
